title:
The source code for `Py4jExecutor` contains
  * the bootstrapping code necessary to create a py4j gateway connection between an external Python process
    and the JVM running the c3 server
  * a Python class that implements the Java interface defined in java/c3/platform/action/py/Py4jExecutorI.java,
    allowing us to invoke actions in the Python process from Java
For more on Py4j, see its official documentation at https://www.py4j.org/index.html, and specifically the section
on initiating communication from Java
https://www.py4j.org/advanced_topics.html#initiating-the-communication-from-the-java-side
name: Py4jExecutor
